versions.content: T he TcpIp IP - layer shall map received IP datagrams to an entry in the local address table (TcpIpAddrId). The local address table mapping is successfully if ALL of the following conditions are fulfilled: a) The receiving interface matches the interface assigned to the local address table entry (EthIfCtrl). b) T he destination IP address contained in the IP header matches the currently assigned IP address of the local address table entry. All IP datagrams which cannot be mapped to an entry in the local address table shall be silently discarded. All successfully mapped IP datagrams shall be forwarded to the upper layer protocol.
